title: A countable generation plus splitting of elements into free summands makes a module free
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a countably generated module M is free provided that whenever M splits as N plus a finite free module, every element of N lies in a free direct summand of N (statement lines 20831-20837). The proof does not produce a basis at once: it enumerates the generators and inductively constructs finite free direct summands F_1, F_2, ... whose partial sums swallow one more generator at each step, at the induction step splitting off a complement N and applying the hypothesis to the image of the next generator inside N, then shrinking the resulting summand to a finite free one (proof lines 20839-20855). Keeping the construction inside the complement at each step is the content, and the author writes the induction out. H2.
